title: FamilyAlias
description: Pure metadata pointer from a family name to (style_id, policy_ids[], domain). Cannot add structure. Loaded from std/procedural/knowledge/aliases/*.json.

family_id.description: Family name this alias resolves. The ONLY place a family name appears in knowledge data — and it carries no behavior, only a pointer.

policy_ids.description: References CompositionPolicy pack policy_ids. Empty array means no policy expansions; the synthesizer runs on the construction graph as authored.

domain.description: Domain routing. Must match a registered DomainExtensionManifest.domain_id.
